title: eugenia urceolata
intro: Eugenia urceolata, commonly known as the Urceolate Eugenia or Urceolate Plum, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is known for its rich antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which offer various health benefits, including protection against oxidative stress, antimicrobial activity, and cardiovascular health support. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia urceolata include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcerogenic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia urceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
